sources.entry: openSIPS - SIP proxy/server for voice, video, IM, presence and any other SIP extensions. (Source Code) GPL-2.0 C

summary.one_liner: OpenSIPS is a GPL-licensed SIP server implementation, forked from the Fraunhofer SER project, for handling SIP signaling and its extensions.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes OpenSIPS as a GPL-licensed SIP server implementation that started as a fork of the Fokus Fraunhofer SIP Express Router (SER) project. It is maintained by OpenSIPS Solutions with a team that includes core developers of SER. The project states its goal is a more open development model and shorter release cycles for new features. Module documentation lives in a README in each module directory, and an overview of modules is referenced on the opensips.org website. The README itself does not list specific features, protocols, or modules in detail. The awesome-selfhosted listing describes it as a SIP proxy/server for voice, video, IM, presence and other SIP extensions.
use_cases: run a SIP proxy or server
handle SIP-based instant messaging or presence
how_to_run: See the INSTALL file in the repository for installation instructions
notable: Forked from the Fraunhofer SER (SIP Express Router) project
Open project management aimed at external contributions
Maintained by OpenSIPS Solutions with former SER core developers
caveats: README is brief and defers most technical detail to INSTALL, module READMEs, and external websites
Requires SIP protocol knowledge to configure and operate
